hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Consider precomputing prefix and suffix aggregations for both greatest common divisor and least common multiple.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: Evaluating the score without removing any item gives a baseline score.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: For each element index, combine the prefix before it and suffix after it to obtain the gcd and lcm in logarithmic time.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Evaluates in optimal O(n * log(max_val)) runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(n) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies optimal pattern to achieve O(n * log(max_val)) complexity.
